objective: Improve JavaScript, TypeScript, and CSS parser/formatter throughput across frozen deterministic large files. Preserve byte-exact formatted output, parser diagnostic hashes, idempotence, relevant parser/formatter regression tests, and peak RSS within 2% of baseline. Only the four pinned parser/formatter crate src trees are mutable.

meta.provenance: Pinned Biome 8ebafe1c7489f1f7af379b8e52b8ad063c82d28a. Workload operations reproduce the uncached parse and format-node/print paths of the upstream JS, TS, and CSS Criterion benches. Third-party CDN benchmark inputs were not redistributed; deterministic large JS/TS/CSS and recovery sources were generated and frozen instead. Round-6: deliberately malformed recovery CSS and formatter edge constructs (previously exercised only by a separate fixed-input selftest mode) are folded into the scored corpus as train/validation recovery.css, so parser error-recovery and formatter edge behavior run under the same nonce-seeded per-iteration input rotation and proof-vs-pristine-reference binding as every other workload, on the timed candidate-indistinguishable path; the separate 'selftest' runner mode was removed. qReference is constructed after locked A-A calibration as qBase + max(5*sigma, 0.05*abs(qBase-qFail)).
meta.license: MIT OR Apache-2.0; upstream notices preserved in baseline/LICENSES and image; generated workloads are CC0-1.0

headroom.requirement: gate-7 development-train headroom: three two-episode seed-optimizer pilots on the current host must produce at least one valid non-baseline candidate while fewer than three runs reach qReference
headroom.pilotPath: trusted supervisor + local backend + broker measurement path under trusted synthetic-meta authority (admissionReview off); no optimizer-queryable state

sourceDetails.offlineDependencies: cargo vendor from the pinned Cargo.lock at toolchain/vendor; CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true; evaluator network disabled

measurement.platform: Docker Desktop Linux arm64 on Apple M3 Max; provisional local calibration
measurement.q: frozen anchor (qBase) scaled by the geometric mean over parse/format workloads of the MEDIAN per-pair reference/candidate wall-time ratio; per workload the candidate and the pristine in-container reference alternate over BENCH_BATCHES=30 fresh-process legs, each batch's candidate leg paired with the reference leg run back-to-back against the same instantaneous host load so common-mode contention cancels within the pair, and the median over pairs rejects pairs where a contention burst hit only one leg; repetitions come from a frozen per-file table (challenge.json) calibrated so every timed leg is ~0.6s of work, equalizing each workload's exposure to load; every timed iteration is bound to the pristine reference via a nonce-keyed proof
measurement.rssGate: peak workload RSS <= frozen ceiling rssLimitKb (28000 KiB); whole-tree kernel cgroup memory.peak accounting; round-6 observed baseline whole-tree peaks with the recovery.css corpus entries: ~24452 KiB train / ~23644 KiB validation (ceiling ~1.15x), so legitimate perturbations clear allocator/measurement variance while gross memory blow-ups are still rejected
